title: Service Contracts: Amendments, Named Accounts and Mid-Term Rate Revisions
content:
An AHL Service Contract can be changed during its term only by amendment. This page covers what gives an amendment effect, the contracts on which amendments can be filed, the ceiling on their number, and two kinds of change with limits of their own: naming affiliated companies and revising base rates.

## Clauses

- **Who asks.** An amendment is requested by the holder of the contract.
- **Signature and filing.** An amendment has no effect until the customer has signed it. It is filed with the regulator on the day of signature and takes effect on filing; it can never be given an effective date in the past.
- **Contract status.** Amendments are filed only on a contract whose status is active.
- **Ceiling per term.** A contract accepts no more than the tier's maximum of filed amendments in its term. Every filed amendment counts towards that ceiling, whatever its kind — a term extension, a change of commitment, the naming of an affiliated company or a rate revision. Where a separate limit governs a single kind, the count for that limit takes in only amendments of that kind.
- **Named accounts.** Affiliated companies may be named to book under the contract, up to the tier's total.
- **Rate revisions.** The base rates can be revised by amendment during the term only in a tier that permits mid-term revision, and then no more often than the tier's number of revisions per term.

## Limits by tier

| Tier | Filed amendments per term, at most | Affiliated companies that may be named, in total | Mid-term rate revision permitted | Rate revisions per term, at most |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AHL Starter Service Contract` | 4 | 0 | no | 0 |
| `AHL Standard Service Contract` | 4 | 2 | no | 0 |
| `AHL Regional Account Contract` | 6 | 5 | no | 0 |
| `AHL Key Account Contract` | 8 | 10 | yes | 2 |
| `AHL Global Account Contract` | 12 | 25 | yes | 3 |
| `AHL Strategic Partner Contract` | 12 | 50 | yes | 4 |

## Cases (hypothetical contracts)

- A Regional Account contract has had six amendments filed this term. A seventh cannot be filed, whatever it concerns.
- A Standard contract already names two affiliated companies; no further company can be named. A Starter contract cannot name any.
- A Key Account contract has had two rate revisions this term. Further revisions are closed to it for the rest of the term; that limit concerns rate revisions only and does not by itself close other kinds of amendment.
- A Regional Account customer asks for its base rates to be revised mid-term. That tier does not permit mid-term revision.
- A customer signs an amendment on 3 June. It is filed and takes effect on 3 June and cannot be dated back to 1 June.
- An amendment is presented on a suspended contract. Suspended contracts do not accept amendments; only active ones do.
